sources.label: Morphe patches for Pdb (pdb.app): premium unlock, ad removal, PairIP bypass and
sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Disables Shima+'s PairIP licence/trial verification, restores the real Application class and removes the licence activity.
Adds the official analytics/Crashlytics collection opt-out flags, disables any Google measurement component and removes the install-referrer permission. Shima+ itself ships no telemetry SDK.

Shima+ ships no ad SDK or ad placement; this additionally disables any ad-SDK auto-init provider and removes the advertising-ID / ad-services / install-referrer permissions so no advertising ID is exposed.
Forces every "pro_unlock" entitlement check to true, unlocking the client-side Pro features without touching the signed purchase store.
